PULP FICTION IS 32 YEARS OLD!⁣ 🎂 
⁣
I’ve never seen Quentin Tarantino be anything other than an enthusiastic and generous interviewee. He never seems to have forgotten where he came from, and you can tell how much he genuinely loves talking about movies. And Pulp Fiction remains one of his absolute best!⁣
⁣
This movie changed the way audiences experienced storytelling in cinema. Instead of following a traditional beginning, middle and end, the film tells several interconnected stories out of chronological order. Characters die in one scene only to reappear alive later, while events that initially seem unrelated gradually reveal their connections. Pulp Fiction didn’t invent non-linear storytelling, but it proved that a film could break the rules of traditional narrative structure and still become a worldwide phenomenon. It inspired a wave of filmmakers to experiment with fragmented timelines, interconnected characters and dialogue-driven stories.⁣
⁣
When people say they don’t like Tarantino movies or that “they’re just about the violence,” I always ask myself: Have they really watched his films? Of course, the violence is there, but his stories are about so much more than that. And even if some people don’t particularly like the stories themselves, man... THIS GUY knows how to TELL a story.⁣
⁣
I wish I could go back in time and experience Pulp Fiction for the first time all over again. Such a fantastic movie!⁣

source_details.synopsis: Pulp Fiction is a 1994 American crime film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino from a story he conceived with Roger Avary. It tells four intertwining tales of crime and violence in Los Angeles. The film stars John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Bruce Willis, Tim Roth, Ving Rhames, and Uma Thurman. The title refers to the pulp magazines and hardboiled crime novels popular during the mid-twentieth century, known for their graphic violence and punchy dialogue. Tarantino wrote Pulp Fiction in 1992 and 1993, incorporating scenes that Avary originally wrote for True Romance (1993). Its plot occurs out of chronological order.
